description: LICHEN epoch rollover test vectors (spec section 4.4). Tests link-layer replay protection across epoch boundaries. The 24-bit counter = (epoch << 16) | seqnum uses unsigned integer ordering. Epoch MUST NOT wrap from 0xFF to 0x00; key rotation is required after (255, 65535).

vectors.name: normal_epoch_increment
vectors.description: Normal transition: epoch increments when seqnum wraps from 65535 to 0
vectors.comment: After (5, 65535), sender increments epoch to 6 and restarts seqnum at 0

vectors.name: epoch_max_boundary
vectors.description: Maximum valid tuple before key rotation is required
vectors.comment: (255, 65535) = 0xFFFFFF is the maximum 24-bit counter. Sender MUST rotate link key before next transmission.

vectors.name: epoch_rollover_forbidden
vectors.description: Epoch rollover from 255 to 0 is forbidden; receiver MUST reject

expected.comment: A lower epoch (0 < 255) is always stale regardless of seqnum

vectors.name: replay_same_epoch_lower_seqnum
vectors.description: Replay detection: same epoch, lower seqnum outside window

vectors.name: replay_lower_epoch
vectors.description: Replay detection: lower epoch is always stale

expected.comment: Even with max seqnum, epoch 9 < 10 means counter 655359 < 655460

vectors.name: accept_higher_epoch
vectors.description: Higher epoch is always accepted (fresh counter)

vectors.name: accept_same_epoch_higher_seqnum
vectors.description: Same epoch, higher seqnum is accepted

vectors.name: tuple_ordering_near_rollover_255_0
vectors.description: Tuple ordering: (255, 0) is counter 16711680, greater than (254, 65535)

vectors.name: tuple_ordering_epoch_0_seqnum_0
vectors.description: Tuple ordering: (0, 0) = 0 is the minimum counter value

vectors.name: replay_cross_epoch_boundary
vectors.description: Replay detection across epoch boundary: old packet from previous epoch

expected.comment: Even though seqnum=65535 is high, epoch 5 < 6 makes this stale

vectors.name: epoch_skip_accepted
vectors.description: Epoch can skip values (e.g., after reboot with random init)

vectors.name: window_acceptance_same_epoch
vectors.description: Out-of-order packet within bitmap window (32-bit) is accepted

vectors.name: window_rejection_duplicate
vectors.description: Duplicate packet within window is rejected

expected.comment: Bit 10 in window (1024 = 0x400) is set, indicating seqnum 990 was already seen

vectors.name: counter_comparison_unsigned
vectors.description: Counter comparison must be unsigned, not modular arithmetic
vectors.comment: Replay protection uses ordinary unsigned integer ordering, NOT serial-number arithmetic

vectors.name: random_init_cold_boot
vectors.description: Cold boot random epoch initialization in [128, 255] range
vectors.comment: Without persisted state, epoch MUST init randomly in [128,255] per spec 4.4
